category_title: Year 4 pupil with ADHD symptoms (hyperactivity, impulsivity, and learning difficulties)
minimal_context: Yiannis is expected to remain seated at his desk and work on his reading assignment during the 90-minute Literacy block.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are starting our 90-minute Literacy block now. Please sit at your desk and begin your reading assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks highly distracted and moves back and forth in his chair in a nervous manner.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your book and keep trying to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows great difficulty sitting on his chair, constantly moving back and forth without looking at the assignment.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yiannis, you need to stay in your seat and do your work.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves his seat completely and begins moving around in the classroom.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are starting our 90-minute Literacy block now. Please sit at your desk and begin your reading assignment.

STUDENT: (Looks highly distracted and moves back and forth in his chair in a nervous manner.)

TUTOR: Please look at your book and keep trying to read.

STUDENT: (Shows great difficulty sitting on his chair, constantly moving back and forth without looking at the assignment.)

TUTOR: Yiannis, you need to stay in your seat and do your work.

STUDENT: (Leaves his seat completely and begins moving around in the classroom.)

context.environment: Sat very close to the teacher's desk, book corner
context.materials: Class rules were pinned on a board close to Yiannis' seat... reader friendly, with different colours, pictures and bold letters, reward chart with sticker from his favourite football club

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Yiannis seemed to be distracted the most during Literacy
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Left his seat and moved around in the classroom

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Great difficulty sitting on his chair and constantly moved back and forth in a nervous manner
